description: Calculate the overlap between two audience criteria sets. Returns overlap_count, overlap_pct (percentage of the smaller population), and demographic_deltas. Each side (a and b) independently accepts EXACTLY ONE of: audience_id, segment_id, segment_ids+set_logic, filter_groups, or filters (more than one per side is rejected with AMBIGUOUS_INPUT). Saved composition, exclusions, and record limits are preserved. Empty optional distributions mean unavailable, not zero. Legacy: pass audience_id_a and audience_id_b at the top level for backward compatibility (mutually exclusive with a/b). Requires 'discovery' scope.
